#define C_IN 128
#define C_OUT 128
#define H_IN 360
#define W_IN 640
#define H_OUT 180
#define W_OUT 320

#define TILE_X 16
#define TILE_Y 8
#define CB 16
#define OCPG 4

#define IN_TILE_H (TILE_Y * 2 + 2)
#define IN_TILE_W (TILE_X * 2 + 2)

Buffer<float16_t> input_0 : register(t0);
Buffer<float16_t> state_0 : register(t1);
Buffer<float16_t> state_1 : register(t2);
Buffer<float16_t> state_2 : register(t3);

RWBuffer<float16_t> output_0 : register(u0);

// Read-only reusable input tile.
// Producers: all 128 threads cooperatively load one 16-channel spatial input tile.
// Consumers: all threads in the group, reused for TILE_X*TILE_Y*OCPG pooled outputs.
// Synchronization: one group barrier after cooperative load.
//
// Read-only compact weight tile.
// Producers: first threads cooperatively load weights for OCPG output channels and CB input channels.
// Consumers: all threads in the group, reused across TILE_X*TILE_Y spatial outputs.
// Synchronization: same group barrier as input tile.
groupshared float16_t gs_in[CB * IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W];
groupshared float16_t gs_w[OCPG * CB * 9];

[WaveSize(32)]
[numthreads(TILE_X, TILE_Y, 1)]
void main(
    uint3 group_id : SV_GroupID,
    uint3 group_thread_id : SV_GroupThreadID,
    uint group_index : SV_GroupIndex)
{
    const uint lx = group_thread_id.x;
    const uint ly = group_thread_id.y;

    const uint tile_ox0 = group_id.x * TILE_X;
    const uint tile_oy0 = group_id.y * TILE_Y;
    const uint oc0 = group_id.z * OCPG;

    const uint out_x = tile_ox0 + lx;
    const uint out_y = tile_oy0 + ly;
    const bool do_write = (out_y < H_OUT);

    float acc00_0 = (float)state_2[oc0 + 0];
    float acc01_0 = acc00_0;
    float acc10_0 = acc00_0;
    float acc11_0 = acc00_0;

    float acc00_1 = (float)state_2[oc0 + 1];
    float acc01_1 = acc00_1;
    float acc10_1 = acc00_1;
    float acc11_1 = acc00_1;

    float acc00_2 = (float)state_2[oc0 + 2];
    float acc01_2 = acc00_2;
    float acc10_2 = acc00_2;
    float acc11_2 = acc00_2;

    float acc00_3 = (float)state_2[oc0 + 3];
    float acc01_3 = acc00_3;
    float acc10_3 = acc00_3;
    float acc11_3 = acc00_3;

    const int in_tile_r0 = (int)(tile_oy0 * 2) - 1;
    const int in_tile_c0 = (int)(tile_ox0 * 2) - 1;
    const bool full_tile = (tile_ox0 > 0) && (tile_ox0 < 304) && (tile_oy0 > 0) && (tile_oy0 < 176);

    [loop]
    for (uint cb0 = 0; cb0 < C_IN; cb0 += CB)
    {
        if (full_tile)
        {
            [loop]
            for (uint idx = group_index; idx < (CB * IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W); idx += (TILE_X * TILE_Y))
            {
                const uint tc = idx % IN_TILE_W;
                const uint tmp0 = idx / IN_TILE_W;
                const uint tr = tmp0 % IN_TILE_H;
                const uint ci = tmp0 / IN_TILE_H;

                const uint in_r = (uint)(in_tile_r0 + (int)tr);
                const uint in_c = (uint)(in_tile_c0 + (int)tc);
                const uint gci = cb0 + ci;
                const uint in_idx = (gci * H_IN + in_r) * W_IN + in_c;
                gs_in[idx] = input_0[in_idx];
            }
        }
        else
        {
            [loop]
            for (uint idx = group_index; idx < (CB * IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W); idx += (TILE_X * TILE_Y))
            {
                const uint tc = idx % IN_TILE_W;
                const uint tmp0 = idx / IN_TILE_W;
                const uint tr = tmp0 % IN_TILE_H;
                const uint ci = tmp0 / IN_TILE_H;

                const int in_r = in_tile_r0 + (int)tr;
                const int in_c = in_tile_c0 + (int)tc;
                const uint gci = cb0 + ci;

                float16_t v = (float16_t)0.0;
                if ((in_r >= 0) && (in_r < H_IN) && (in_c >= 0) && (in_c < W_IN))
                {
                    const uint in_idx = (gci * H_IN + (uint)in_r) * W_IN + (uint)in_c;
                    v = input_0[in_idx];
                }
                gs_in[idx] = v;
            }
        }

        [loop]
        for (uint idxw = group_index; idxw < (OCPG * CB * 9); idxw += (TILE_X * TILE_Y))
        {
            const uint k = idxw % 9;
            const uint tmpw = idxw / 9;
            const uint ci = tmpw % CB;
            const uint ocp = tmpw / CB;
            const uint oc = oc0 + ocp;
            const uint gci = cb0 + ci;
            const uint w_idx = ((oc * C_IN + gci) * 3 + (k / 3)) * 3 + (k % 3);
            gs_w[idxw] = state_1[w_idx];
        }

        GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();

        const uint base_r = ly * 2;
        const uint base_c = lx * 2;

        [unroll]
        for (uint ci = 0; ci < CB; ++ci)
        {
            const uint in_base_ci = ci * IN_TILE_H * IN_TILE_W;

            [unroll]
            for (uint kh = 0; kh < 3; ++kh)
            {
                const uint r0 = base_r + kh;
                const uint r1 = r0 + 1;
                const uint in_row0 = in_base_ci + r0 * IN_TILE_W;
                const uint in_row1 = in_base_ci + r1 * IN_TILE_W;

                [unroll]
                for (uint kw = 0; kw < 3; ++kw)
                {
                    const uint c0 = base_c + kw;
                    const uint c1 = c0 + 1;

                    const float v00 = (float)gs_in[in_row0 + c0];
                    const float v01 = (float)gs_in[in_row0 + c1];
                    const float v10 = (float)gs_in[in_row1 + c0];
                    const float v11 = (float)gs_in[in_row1 + c1];

                    const uint wk = ci * 9 + kh * 3 + kw;
                    const float w0 = (float)gs_w[wk];
                    const float w1 = (float)gs_w[CB * 9 + wk];
                    const float w2 = (float)gs_w[2 * CB * 9 + wk];
                    const float w3 = (float)gs_w[3 * CB * 9 + wk];

                    acc00_0 = mad(v00, w0, acc00_0);
                    acc01_0 = mad(v01, w0, acc01_0);
                    acc10_0 = mad(v10, w0, acc10_0);
                    acc11_0 = mad(v11, w0, acc11_0);

                    acc00_1 = mad(v00, w1, acc00_1);
                    acc01_1 = mad(v01, w1, acc01_1);
                    acc10_1 = mad(v10, w1, acc10_1);
                    acc11_1 = mad(v11, w1, acc11_1);

                    acc00_2 = mad(v00, w2, acc00_2);
                    acc01_2 = mad(v01, w2, acc01_2);
                    acc10_2 = mad(v10, w2, acc10_2);
                    acc11_2 = mad(v11, w2, acc11_2);

                    acc00_3 = mad(v00, w3, acc00_3);
                    acc01_3 = mad(v01, w3, acc01_3);
                    acc10_3 = mad(v10, w3, acc10_3);
                    acc11_3 = mad(v11, w3, acc11_3);
                }
            }
        }

        GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();
    }

    if (do_write)
    {
        acc00_0 = max(acc00_0, 0.0);
        acc01_0 = max(acc01_0, 0.0);
        acc10_0 = max(acc10_0, 0.0);
        acc11_0 = max(acc11_0, 0.0);

        acc00_1 = max(acc00_1, 0.0);
        acc01_1 = max(acc01_1, 0.0);
        acc10_1 = max(acc10_1, 0.0);
        acc11_1 = max(acc11_1, 0.0);

        acc00_2 = max(acc00_2, 0.0);
        acc01_2 = max(acc01_2, 0.0);
        acc10_2 = max(acc10_2, 0.0);
        acc11_2 = max(acc11_2, 0.0);

        acc00_3 = max(acc00_3, 0.0);
        acc01_3 = max(acc01_3, 0.0);
        acc10_3 = max(acc10_3, 0.0);
        acc11_3 = max(acc11_3, 0.0);

        const uint out_idx0 = (oc0 * H_OUT + out_y) * W_OUT + out_x;
        const uint out_idx1 = ((oc0 + 1) * H_OUT + out_y) * W_OUT + out_x;
        const uint out_idx2 = ((oc0 + 2) * H_OUT + out_y) * W_OUT + out_x;
        const uint out_idx3 = ((oc0 + 3) * H_OUT + out_y) * W_OUT + out_x;

        output_0[out_idx0] = (float16_t)((acc00_0 + acc01_0 + acc10_0 + acc11_0) * 0.25);
        output_0[out_idx1] = (float16_t)((acc00_1 + acc01_1 + acc10_1 + acc11_1) * 0.25);
        output_0[out_idx2] = (float16_t)((acc00_2 + acc01_2 + acc10_2 + acc11_2) * 0.25);
        output_0[out_idx3] = (float16_t)((acc00_3 + acc01_3 + acc10_3 + acc11_3) * 0.25);
    }
}
